{{Quote|T7 &#61; detected assassin in crowd // T7 &#61; discharged stun bolt // Assassin &#61; dropped blaster and escaped in crowd|translated=1|T7-O1|<ref name="The Assassination" />}}
A '''member''' of the [[GenoHaradan]], a secret society of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], was active during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="The Assassination" /> In [[3663 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}} Adding twenty years to the date of 3,643 BBY gives a resultant date of 3,663 BBY.</ref> the assassin was tasked with the elimination of a [[Unidentified Muun ambassador|Muun ambassador]], and attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the target while in the middle of a crowd. However, the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], who had been assigned to protect the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]], fired a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] bolt into the crowd, and the assassin dropped their [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and fled in the resultant chaos. The assassin was never caught, and the [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] decided to resign in order to forestall any more assassination attempts.<ref name="The Assassination" />

==Behind the scenes==
The GenoHaradan assassin was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="The Assassination" />
